subject: Upcoming Team Building Event
body: Dear Team, I am excited to announce that we will be having a team building event next month at the local adventure park. This will be a great opportunity for us to bond outside of work and strengthen our team dynamics. The event will include various activities such as team challenges, games, and a barbecue lunch. Please mark your calendars and stay tuned for more details on the schedule and logistics. Let's make this a fun and memorable experience for all of us! Best regards, [Your Name]
